lead.event: Rupiah reaches a record low as the IHSG declines
lead.headline: Rupiah hits record low of Rp18,288 as IHSG declines
lead.blurb: The IHSG is 41% below its peak, with pressure compounded by expected US Federal Reserve rate hikes and a potential MSCI reclassification that could trigger US$10 billion in outflows. Alamtri Resources and Indo Tambangraya are cited for natural hedging, trading at 0.77 and 0.76 times book value, respectively. Pharmaceuticals and automotive assembly face margin pressure from dollar-priced imported inputs.
lead.copy_decision: kept: 1 new articles, no new fact

capital_raising_buybacks.event: ENRG secures a US$220 million Deutsche Bank facility for HighPeak investment
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: ENRG secures up to US$220 million Deutsche Bank facility for HighPeak investment
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Energi Mega Persada signed the facility on 13 November to fund its US$200 million participation in newly issued HighPeak convertible preferred shares. They may convert into common shares at US$9.5 each, and HighPeak will use the funds to strengthen its capital structure, including refinancing US$1.17 billion in debt.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Bank Kasikorn Indonesia plans a Rp1 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BMAS plans Rp1 trillion rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Kasikorn Indonesia plans to use the proceeds for working capital to support lending, with use planned over up to 12 months. The 2.87 billion new shares are priced at Rp350 each and represent 13.70% of post-offer paid-up capital. Major shareholder Kasikorn Vision Financial will exercise its rights and buy any shares left unsubscribed; rights trading and exercise run from 27 November to 3 December.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BMAS plans to use the rights issue proceeds for working capital to support lending.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: GMFI plans a rights issue of up to 22.03 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: GMFI plans rights issue to raise about Rp1.05 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: GMF Asia says shareholders who do not subscribe could face dilution of up to 15%. The plan requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting on 8 December 2026.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Harum Energy ends its share buyback program early
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: HRUM ends Rp120 billion share buyback early
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Harum Energy ended the program effective 17 November, citing capital-market rules and a restructuring plan being prepared by its controlling shareholders. Announced on 25 September, the buyback was set to cover up to 111 million shares, about 0.82% of issued and paid-up capital, through 24 December. The board said another buyback may be conducted under applicable rules.

deals_control.event: Cakrawala Nexus acquires a 29.87% stake in INET
deals_control.headline: Cakrawala Nexus acquires 29.87% of INET for Rp2 trillion
deals_control.blurb: The DOOH-affiliated buyer completed the purchase on 16 November at Rp300 per share from INET controller Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara. The seller’s direct stake fell from 59.76% to 29.89%, but it retained control.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The acquisition of 29.87% of INET for Rp2 trillion was completed on 16 November, while the seller retained control.

other.event: MMIX shares hit the auto-rejection bottom after a sharp decline
other.headline: MMIX hits lower price limit after 6.81% fall to Rp356
other.blurb: Multi Medika Internasional had fallen for 12 consecutive trading days since 2 November, losing more than 55% from Rp795 on 30 October. Sell queues at Rp356 reached about 154,186 lots by 09:22 WIB on 17 November.

earnings_guidance.event: BRI reports Q3 2026 operating and financial performance
earnings_guidance.headline: BBRI reports 14.5% loan growth to Rp1,647 trillion through Q3 2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI’s NPL ratio fell to 2.85% in September from 3.1% a year earlier. Net profit attributable to owners reached Rp16.8 trillion in Q3, up 16% year on year, bringing nine-month profit to Rp47.7 trillion, up 16.9%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 2 new articles with a new fact: BRI’s NPL ratio fell to 2.85% in September 2026 from 3.1% a year earlier.

earnings_guidance.event: Ekamas Mora reports 9M2026 revenue and profit growth
earnings_guidance.headline: MORA reports about 78% revenue and 118% profit growth in 9M2026
earnings_guidance.blurb: Ekamas Mora recorded Rp5 trillion in revenue, compared with Rp2.8 trillion a year earlier, and net profit attributable to owners of the parent entity of Rp506.75 billion, versus Rp231.55 billion. Revenue from internet telecommunications service customers rose to Rp3.35 trillion from Rp990.63 billion.

earnings_guidance.event: Cimory plans price increases to recover margins
earnings_guidance.headline: CMRY plans Q4 price increases as gross margin falls to 42.1%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Cisarua Mountain Dairy plans to raise dairy product prices in Q4 2026 to offset pressure from raw material and packaging costs. Mirae Asset Sekuritas said the adjustment could restore gross margin to 42%-44%.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Sido Muncul reports Q3 2026 results and raises analyst estimates
earnings_guidance.headline: SIDO reports Q3 profit up 30.9% to Rp285 billion as Mirae considers estimate revisions
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sido Muncul's revenue reached Rp1.03 trillion, up 14.7% year on year, while EBITDA rose 27.5% to Rp395 billion. Nine-month revenue, net profit and EBITDA reached 70%, 76% and 75% of Mirae Asset's 2026 projections, while management still expects 2026 revenue and profit to decline 10% and 24%, respectively.
